name: Lactation consultant

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Lactation visit at the office
services.story: The main story: a lactation visit at the office, billed to the family's plan. Nothing is taken when booking; the desk checks the plan, and any share is paid at the front desk.

services.name: Free phone chat
services.story: The free 15-minute phone chat: nothing is taken and nothing is to pay.

services.name: Video lactation visit
services.story: A video lactation visit, paid in full when booking.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: Ivo (lactation consultant) and Pia (lactation consultant), who visit at home

services.name: Lactation visit at home
services.story: The main story: a lactation visit at home, self-pay. Nothing is taken when booking; Rosie texts the $150 bill after the visit.

services.name: Lactation visit at home (plan)
services.story: The same visit billed to the family's plan: nothing taken at booking; the office bills the plan its own way.

services.name: Lactation visit at home (paid)
services.story: A lactation visit at home, paid in full when booking.

services_shape: breastfeeding support for a parent and baby: visits at the office, at home, or by video; a free phone chat to ask if a visit fits; visits are booked one at a time, with the next at checkout
questions_before_times: the first name of the parent booking
a new family or a current one
which visit: the office's own visit types only, never a symptom typed into the AI
where the visit is: at the office, by video, or at home (home visits only inside the business's area)
a plan (its name only) or self-pay
safety_stop: trouble breathing, a seizure, a baby who isn't breathing, a baby who is blue or won't wake up, or heavy bleeding
thoughts of harming yourself or the baby, or a crisis after the birth
first_steps: The feeding history, the health history and the consent
A written price estimate for a self-pay family
The owner's OK for a new family
license: optional, and never verified by Rosie: a consultant may add a lactation certification it holds (IBCLC or similar), and the business may add a registration; Rosie looks nothing up and never says anything is checked
staff_skills: lactation consultants: office and home visits, video visits and weight checks; only consultants the owner clears go to homes
messages_never: texts carry only the business's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the feeding, the baby's weight, symptoms or results (at a home visit the consultant's name stays, for the door check)
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
